label: preserve durable writes setting
type: an Enterprise-Edition-only cluster setting that suppresses automatic failover of a node when failing it over could lose durably-written data - trading availability for the durability guarantee.
evidence: If you enable this setting, Couchbase Server does not auto-fail over a node if it could result in the loss of durably written data.
the setting to preserve durable writes is not available
note: The resolution of a contradiction the registry already contained implicitly: durability.md says 'Both manual and automatic failovers can cause the loss of durably written data', and this setting is the documented way to stop the automatic half from doing so.
